all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.saheeh: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
translations.pickthall: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
translations.khattab: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim
translations.arberry: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, above that they describe.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهࣱ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهࣱۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

translations.saheeh: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
translations.pickthall: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.
translations.khattab: It is He Who is ˹the only˺ God in the heavens and ˹the only˺ God on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing
translations.arberry: And it is He who in heaven is God and in earth is God; He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

translations.saheeh: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
translations.pickthall: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.
translations.khattab: And Blessed is the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between! With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned
translations.arberry: Glory be to Him, to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that between them is; with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you shall be returned.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

translations.saheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
translations.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.
translations.khattab: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith
translations.arberry: Lord of the heavens and earth, and all that between them is if you have faith.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
translations.pickthall: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
translations.khattab: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible
translations.arberry: So be on the watch for a day when heaven shall bring a manifest smoke

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ

translations.saheeh: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
translations.pickthall: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
translations.khattab: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed
translations.arberry: Neither heaven nor earth wept for them, nor were they respited;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

translations.saheeh: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
translations.pickthall: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.
translations.khattab: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport
translations.arberry: We created not the heavens and earth, and all that between them is, in play;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
translations.pickthall: Lo! in the heavens and the earth are portents for believers.
translations.khattab: Surely in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers
translations.arberry: Surely in the heavens and earth there are signs for the believers;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقࣲ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتࣱ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَعۡقِلُونَ

translations.saheeh: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
translations.pickthall: And the difference of night and day and the provision that Allah sendeth down from the sky and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death, and the ordering of the winds, are portents for a people who have sense.
translations.khattab: And ˹in˺ the alternation of the day and the night, the provision sent down from the skies by Allah—reviving the earth after its death—and the shifting of the winds, are signs for people of understanding
translations.arberry: and in the alternation of night and day, and the provision God sends down from heaven, and therewith revives the earth after it is dead, and the turning about of the winds, there are signs for a people who understand.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعࣰ ا مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

translations.saheeh: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
translations.pickthall: And hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect.
translations.khattab: He ˹also˺ subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth—all by His grace. Surely in this are signs for people who reflect
translations.arberry: And He has subjected to you what is in the heavens and what is in the earth, all together, from Him. Surely in that are signs for a people who reflect.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
translations.pickthall: And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged.
translations.khattab: For Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose, so that every soul may be paid back for what it has committed. And none will be wronged
translations.arberry: God created the heavens and the earth in truth, and that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned; they shall not be wronged.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَخۡسَرُ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ

translations.saheeh: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
translations.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost.
translations.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. On the Day the Hour will be established, the people of falsehood will then be in ˹total˺ loss
translations.arberry: To God belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And on the day when the Hour is come, upon that day the vain-doers shall lose.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
translations.pickthall: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.khattab: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds
translations.arberry: So to God belongs praise, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, Lord of all Being.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

translations.saheeh: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.pickthall: And unto Him (alone) belongeth Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: To Him belongs ˹all˺ Majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise
translations.arberry: His is the Domination an the heavens and the earth; He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلࣲ مُّسَمࣰّ ىۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُواْ مُعۡرِضُونَ

translations.saheeh: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
translations.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.
translations.khattab: We only created the heavens and the earth and everything in between for a purpose and an appointed term. Yet the disbelievers are turning away from what they have been warned about
translations.arberry: We have not created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, save with the truth and a stated term; but the unbelievers are turning away from that they were warned of.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلࣲ مُّسَمࣰّ ىۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُواْ مُعۡرِضُونَ

translations.saheeh: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
translations.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.
translations.khattab: We only created the heavens and the earth and everything in between for a purpose and an appointed term. Yet the disbelievers are turning away from what they have been warned about
translations.arberry: We have not created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, save with the truth and a stated term; but the unbelievers are turning away from that they were warned of.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شِرۡكࣱ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِۖ ٱئۡتُونِي بِكِتَٰبࣲ مِّن قَبۡلِ هَٰذَآ أَوۡ أَثَٰرَةࣲ مِّنۡ عِلۡمٍ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

translations.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
translations.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful.
translations.khattab: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Have you considered whatever ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created on earth! Or do they have a share in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens? Bring me a scripture ˹revealed˺ before this ˹Quran˺ or a shred of knowledge, if what you say is true.”
translations.arberry: Say: 'Have you considered that you call upon apart from God? Show me what they have created of the earth; or have they a partnership in the heavens? Bring me a Book before this, or some remnant of a knowledge, if you speak truly.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَمۡ يَعۡيَ بِخَلۡقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
translations.pickthall: Have they not seen that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and was not wearied by their creation, is Able to give life to the dead? Aye, He verily is Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: Do they not realize that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and did not tire in creating them, is able to give life to the dead? Yes ˹indeed˺! He is certainly Most Capable of everything
translations.arberry: What, have they not seen that God who created the heavens and earth, not being wearied by creating them, is able to give life to the dead? Yes indeed; He is powerful over everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ لِيَزۡدَادُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنࣰ ا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allah Knowing and Wise.
translations.pickthall: He it is Who sent down peace of reassurance into the hearts of the believers that they might add faith unto their faith. Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Knower, Wise -
translations.khattab: He is the One Who sent down serenity upon the hearts of the believers so that they may increase even more in their faith. To Allah ˹alone˺ belong the forces of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
translations.arberry: It is He who sent down the Shechina (tranquillity) into the hearts of the believers, that they might add faith to their faith -- to God belong the hosts of the heavens and the earth; God is All-knowing, All-wise --

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا

translations.saheeh: And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.
translations.pickthall: Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.
translations.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belong the forces of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Almighty, All-Wise
translations.arberry: To God belong the hosts of the heavens and the earth; God is All-mighty, All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَغۡفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورࣰ ا رَّحِيمࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
translations.pickthall: And Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He forgiveth whom He will, and punisheth whom He will. And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
translations.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whoever He wills, and punishes whoever He wills. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
translations.arberry: To God belongs the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth; whomsoever He will He forgives, and whomsoever He will He chastises; God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمࣱ مِّن قَوۡمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُواْ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا نِسَآءࣱ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُنَّۖ وَلَا تَلۡمِزُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَلَا تَنَابَزُواْ بِٱلۡأَلۡقَٰبِۖ بِئۡسَ ٱلِٱسۡمُ ٱلۡفُسُوقُ بَعۡدَ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِۚ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَتُبۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

translations.saheeh: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
translations.pickthall: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.
translations.khattab: O believers! Do not let some ˹men˺ ridicule others, they may be better than them, nor let ˹some˺ women ridicule other women, they may be better than them. Do not defame one another, nor call each other by offensive nicknames. How evil it is to act rebelliously after having faith! And whoever does not repent, it is they who are the ˹true˺ wrongdoers
translations.arberry: O believers, let not any people scoff at another people who may be better than they; neither let women scoff at women who may be better than themselves. And find not fault with one another, neither revile one another by nicknames. An evil name is ungodliness after belief. And whoso repents not, those -- they are the evildoers.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قُلۡ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمۡ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Say, "Would you acquaint Allah with your religion while Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is Knowing of all things?"
translations.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things?
translations.khattab: Say, “Do you inform Allah of your faith, when Allah ˹already˺ knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth? And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.”
translations.arberry: Say: 'What, would you teach God what your religion is, and God knows what is in the heavens and what is in the earth? And God has knowledge of everything.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, Allah knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.
translations.pickthall: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
translations.khattab: Surely Allah knows the unseen of the heavens and earth. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.”
translations.arberry: God knows the Unseen of the heavens and of the earth; and God sees the things you do.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
translations.pickthall: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?
translations.khattab: Have they not then looked at the sky above them: how We built it and adorned it ˹with stars˺, leaving it flawless
translations.arberry: What, have they not beheld heaven above them, how We have built it, and decked it out fair, and it has no cracks?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ مُّبَٰرَكࣰ ا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ

translations.saheeh: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
translations.pickthall: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,
translations.khattab: And We send down blessed rain from the sky, bringing forth gardens and grains for harvest
translations.arberry: And We sent down out of heaven water blessed, and caused to grow thereby gardens and grain of harvest

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
translations.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
translations.khattab: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue
translations.arberry: We created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, in six days, and no weariness touched Us.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ

translations.saheeh: By the heaven containing pathways,
translations.pickthall: By the heaven full of paths,
translations.khattab: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design
translations.arberry: By heaven with all its tracks

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

translations.saheeh: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
translations.pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
translations.khattab: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised
translations.arberry: And in heaven is your provision, and that you are promised.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقࣱّ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
translations.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
translations.khattab: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak
translations.arberry: So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدࣲ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

translations.saheeh: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
translations.pickthall: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
translations.khattab: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺
translations.arberry: And heaven -- We built it with might, and We extend it wide.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
translations.pickthall: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
translations.khattab: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently
translations.arberry: Upon the day when heaven spins dizzily

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

translations.saheeh: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
translations.pickthall: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
translations.khattab: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺
translations.arberry: Or did they create the heavens and earth? Nay, but they have not sure faith.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطࣰ ا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابࣱ مَّرۡكُومࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
translations.pickthall: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
translations.khattab: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”
translations.arberry: Even if they saw lumps falling from heaven, they would say, 'A massed cloud!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءࣱ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
translations.pickthall: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
translations.khattab: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord
translations.arberry: They are naught but names yourselves have named, and your fathers; God has sent down no authority touching them. They follow only surmise, and what the souls desire; and yet guidance has come to them from their Lord.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءࣱ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
translations.pickthall: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
translations.khattab: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord
translations.arberry: They are naught but names yourselves have named, and your fathers; God has sent down no authority touching them. They follow only surmise, and what the souls desire; and yet guidance has come to them from their Lord.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكࣲ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
translations.pickthall: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.
translations.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves
translations.arberry: How many an angel there is in the heavens whose intercession avails not anything, save after that God gives leave to whomsoever He wills and is well-pleased.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
translations.pickthall: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.
translations.khattab: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female
translations.arberry: Those who do not believe in the world to come name the angels with the names of females.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
translations.pickthall: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.
translations.khattab: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female
translations.arberry: Those who do not believe in the world to come name the angels with the names of females.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى

translations.saheeh: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
translations.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.
translations.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—
translations.arberry: To God belongs whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may recompense those who do evil for what they have done, and recompense those who have done good with the reward most fair.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءࣲ مُّنۡهَمِرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
translations.pickthall: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water
translations.khattab: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain
translations.arberry: Then We opened the gates of heaven unto water torrential,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ

translations.saheeh: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
translations.pickthall: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
translations.khattab: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺
translations.arberry: and heaven -- He raised it up, and set the Balance.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
translations.pickthall: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
translations.khattab: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about
translations.arberry: Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth implore Him; every day He is upon some labour.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
translations.pickthall: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
translations.khattab: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority
translations.arberry: O tribe of jinn and of men, if you are able to pass through the confines of heaven and earth, pass through them! You shall not pass through except with an authority.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةࣰ كَٱلدِّهَانِ

translations.saheeh: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
translations.pickthall: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -
translations.khattab: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil
translations.arberry: And when heaven is split asunder, and turns crimson like red leather --

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ

translations.saheeh: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
translations.pickthall: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!
translations.khattab: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour
translations.arberry: Blessed be the Name of thy Lord, majestic, splendid.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

translations.saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
translations.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
translations.arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

translations.saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
translations.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
translations.arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

translations.saheeh: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah, for He is the Almighty, All-Wise
translations.arberry: All that is in the heavens and the earth magnifies God; He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرٌ

translations.saheeh: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
translations.pickthall: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death. And He is Most Capable of everything
translations.arberry: To Him belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth; He gives life, and He makes to die, and He is powerful over everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
translations.pickthall: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
translations.khattab: He is the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatever comes out of it, and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends into it. And He is with you wherever you are. For Allah is All-Seeing of what you do
translations.arberry: It is He that created the heavens and the earth in six days then seated Himself upon the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes forth from it, -- what comes down from heaven, and what goes up unto it. He is with you wherever you are; and God sees the things you do.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
translations.pickthall: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
translations.khattab: He is the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatever comes out of it, and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends into it. And He is with you wherever you are. For Allah is All-Seeing of what you do
translations.arberry: It is He that created the heavens and the earth in six days then seated Himself upon the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes forth from it, -- what comes down from heaven, and what goes up unto it. He is with you wherever you are; and God sees the things you do.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ

translations.saheeh: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned [all] matters.
translations.pickthall: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back.
translations.khattab: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And to Allah all matters are returned
translations.arberry: To Him belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and unto Him all matters are returned.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا لَكُمۡ أَلَّا تُنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ لَا يَسۡتَوِي مِنكُم مَّنۡ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبۡلِ ٱلۡفَتۡحِ وَقَٰتَلَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَعۡظَمُ دَرَجَةࣰ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدُ وَقَٰتَلُواْۚ وَكُلࣰّ ا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allah has promised the best [reward]. And Allah, with what you do, is Acquainted.
translations.pickthall: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.
translations.khattab: And why should you not spend in the cause of Allah, while Allah is the ˹sole˺ inheritor of the heavens and the earth? Those of you who donated and fought before the victory ˹over Mecca˺ are unparalleled. They are far greater in rank than those who donated and fought afterwards. Yet Allah has promised each a fine reward. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do
translations.arberry: How is it with you, that you expend not in the way of God, and to God belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Not equal is he among you who spent, and who fought before the victory; those are mightier in rank than they who spent and fought afterwards; and unto each God has promised the reward most fair; and God is aware of the things you do.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَابِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَغۡفِرَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرۡضُهَا كَعَرۡضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
translations.pickthall: Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.
translations.khattab: ˹So˺ compete with one another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. This is the favour of Allah. He grants it to whoever He wills. And Allah is the Lord of infinite bounty
translations.arberry: Race to forgiveness from your Lord, and a Garden the breadth whereof is as the breadth of heaven and earth, made ready for those who believe in God and His Messengers. That is the bounty of God; He gives it unto whomsoever He will; and God is of bounty abounding.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجۡوَىٰ ثَلَٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمۡ وَلَا خَمۡسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكۡثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كَانُواْۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ

translations.saheeh: Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing.
translations.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth? There is no secret conference of three but He is their fourth, nor of five but He is their sixth, nor of less than that or more but He is with them wheresoever they may be; and afterward, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things.
translations.khattab: Do you not see that Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth? If three converse privately, He is their fourth. If five, He is their sixth. Whether fewer or more, He is with them wherever they may be. Then, on the Day of Judgment, He will inform them of what they have done. Surely Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things
translations.arberry: God has numbered it, and they have forgotten it. God is witness over everything. Hast thou not seen that God knows whatsoever is in the heavens, and whatsoever is in the earth? Three men conspire not secretly together, but He is the fourth of them, neither five men, but He is the sixth of them, neither fewer than that, neither more, but He is with them, wherever they may be; then He shall tell them what they have done, on the Day of Resurrection. Surely God has knowledge of everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

translations.saheeh: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth glorifies Allah. For He is the Almighty, All-Wise
translations.arberry: All that is in the heavens and the earth magnifies God; He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُ ٱلۡبَارِئُ ٱلۡمُصَوِّرُۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

translations.saheeh: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.pickthall: He is Allah, the Creator, the Shaper out of naught, the Fashioner. His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: He is Allah: the Creator, the Inventor, the Shaper. He ˹alone˺ has the Most Beautiful Names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth ˹constantly˺ glorifies Him. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise
translations.arberry: He is God, the Creator, the Maker, the Shaper. To Him belong the Names Most Beautiful. All that is in the heavens and the earth magnifies Him; He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُ ٱلۡبَارِئُ ٱلۡمُصَوِّرُۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

translations.saheeh: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.pickthall: He is Allah, the Creator, the Shaper out of naught, the Fashioner. His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: He is Allah: the Creator, the Inventor, the Shaper. He ˹alone˺ has the Most Beautiful Names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth ˹constantly˺ glorifies Him. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise
translations.arberry: He is God, the Creator, the Maker, the Shaper. To Him belong the Names Most Beautiful. All that is in the heavens and the earth magnifies Him; He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

translations.saheeh: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth glorifies Allah. For He ˹alone˺ is the Almighty, All-Wise
translations.arberry: All that is in the heavens and the earth magnifies God; He is the All-mighty; the All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيۡكُم مُّصَدِّقࣰ ا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرَۢا بِرَسُولࣲ يَأۡتِي مِنۢ بَعۡدِي ٱسۡمُهُۥٓ أَحۡمَدُۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allah to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Ahmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic."
translations.pickthall: And when Jesus son of Mary said: O Children of Israel! Lo! I am the messenger of Allah unto you, confirming that which was (revealed) before me in the Torah, and bringing good tidings of a messenger who cometh after me, whose name is the Praised One. Yet when he hath come unto them with clear proofs, they say: This is mere magic.
translations.khattab: And ˹remember˺ when Jesus, son of Mary, said, “O children of Israel! I am truly Allah’s messenger to you, confirming the Torah which came before me, and giving good news of a messenger after me whose name will be Aḥmad.” Yet when the Prophet came to them with clear proofs, they said, “This is pure magic.”
translations.arberry: And when Jesus son of Mary said, 'Children of Israel, I am indeed the Messenger of God to you, confirming the Torah that is before me, and giving good tidings of a Messenger who shall come after me, whose name shall be Ahmad.' Then, when he brought them the clear signs, they said, 'This is a manifest sorcery.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡمَلِكِ ٱلۡقُدُّوسِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth ˹constantly˺ glorifies Allah—the King, the Most Holy, the Almighty, the All-Wise
translations.arberry: All that is in the heavens and the earth magnifies God, the King, the All-holy, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُواْ عَلَىٰ مَنۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّواْۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ

translations.saheeh: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah until they disband." And to Allah belongs the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.
translations.pickthall: They it is who say: Spend not on behalf of those (who dwell) with Allah's messenger that they may disperse (and go away from you); when Allah's are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the hypocrites comprehend not.
translations.khattab: They are the ones who say ˹to one another˺, “Do not spend ˹anything˺ on those ˹emigrants˺ with the Messenger of Allah so that they will break away ˹from him˺.” But to Allah ˹alone˺ belong the treasuries of the heavens and the earth, yet the hypocrites do not comprehend
translations.arberry: Those are they that say, 'Do not expend on them that are with God's Messenger until they scatter off'; yet unto God belong the treasuries of the heavens and of the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرٌ

translations.saheeh: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.
translations.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah; unto Him belongeth Sovereignty and unto Him belongeth praise, and He is Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth ˹constantly˺ glorifies Allah. The kingdom is His, and all praise is for Him. For He is Most Capable of everything
translations.arberry: All that is in the heavens and the earth magnifies God. His is the Kingdom, and His is the praise, and He is powerful over everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَأَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

translations.saheeh: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
translations.pickthall: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and unto Him is the journeying.
translations.khattab: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. He shaped you ˹in the womb˺, perfecting your form. And to Him is the final return
translations.arberry: He created the heavens and the earth with the truth, and He shaped you, and shaped you well; and unto Him is the homecoming.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

translations.saheeh: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts.
translations.pickthall: He knoweth all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He knoweth what ye conceal and what ye publish. And Allah is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men).
translations.khattab: He knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth. And He knows whatever you conceal and whatever you reveal. For Allah knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart
translations.arberry: He knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and He knows what you conceal and what you publish. God knows the thoughts within the breasts.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِثۡلَهُنَّۖ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنَهُنَّ لِتَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمَۢا

translations.saheeh: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.
translations.pickthall: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.
translations.khattab: Allah is the One Who created seven heavens ˹in layers˺, and likewise for the earth. The ˹divine˺ command descends between them so you may know that Allah is Most Capable of everything and that Allah certainly encompasses all things in ˹His˺ knowledge
translations.arberry: It is God who created seven heavens, and of earth their like, between them the Command descending, that you may know that God is powerful over everything and that God encompasses everything in knowledge.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ اۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتࣲۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
translations.pickthall: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts?
translations.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who created seven heavens, one above the other. You will never see any imperfection in the creation of the Most Compassionate. So look again: do you see any flaws
translations.arberry: who created seven heavens one upon another. Thou seest not in the creation of the All-merciful any imperfection. Return thy gaze; seest thou any fissure?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومࣰ ا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

translations.saheeh: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
translations.pickthall: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.
translations.khattab: And indeed, We adorned the lowest heaven with ˹stars like˺ lamps, and made them ˹as missiles˺ for stoning ˹eavesdropping˺ devils, for whom We have also prepared the torment of the Blaze
translations.arberry: And We adorned the lower heaven with lamps, and made them things to stone Satans; and We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blaze.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ

translations.saheeh: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
translations.pickthall: Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed?
translations.khattab: Do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you up as it quakes violently
translations.arberry: Do you feel secure that He who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you, the while it rocks?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبࣰ اۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ

translations.saheeh: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
translations.pickthall: Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let loose on you a hurricane? But ye shall know the manner of My warning.
translations.khattab: Or do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not unleash upon you a storm of stones. Only then would you know how ˹serious˺ My warning was
translations.arberry: Do you feel secure that He who is in heaven will not loose against you a squall of pebbles, then you shall know how My warning is?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِيَ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ وَاهِيَةࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
translations.pickthall: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.
translations.khattab: The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail
translations.arberry: and heaven shall be split, for upon that day it shall be very frail,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

translations.saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.pickthall: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
translations.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
translations.arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ

translations.saheeh: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
translations.pickthall: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,
translations.khattab: On that Day the sky will be like molten brass
translations.arberry: Upon the day when heaven shall be as molten copper

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
translations.pickthall: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.
translations.khattab: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”
translations.arberry: and He will forgive you your sins, and defer you to a stated term; God's term, when it comes, cannot be deferred, did you but know."'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
translations.pickthall: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
translations.khattab: He will shower you with abundant rain
translations.arberry: and He will loose heaven upon you in torrents

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
translations.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
translations.khattab: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other
translations.arberry: Have you not regarded how God created seven heavens one upon another,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَشُهُبࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
translations.pickthall: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.
translations.khattab: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars
translations.arberry: And we stretched towards heaven, but we found it filled with terrible guards and meteors.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
translations.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
translations.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly
translations.arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord, and devote thyself unto Him very devoutly.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا

translations.saheeh: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
translations.pickthall: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.
translations.khattab: It will ˹even˺ cause the sky to split apart. His promise ˹of judgment˺ must be fulfilled
translations.arberry: Whereby heaven shall be split, and its promise shall be performed.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: عَيۡنࣰ ا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
translations.pickthall: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
translations.khattab: from a spring there, called Salsabîl
translations.arberry: therein a fountain whose name is called Salsabil.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَأَصِيلࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
translations.pickthall: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
translations.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening
translations.arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord at dawn and in the evening

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتۡ

translations.saheeh: And when the heaven is opened
translations.pickthall: And when the sky is riven asunder,
translations.khattab: and the sky is torn apart
translations.arberry: when heaven shall be split

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
translations.pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
translations.khattab: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates
translations.arberry: and heaven is opened, and become gates,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
translations.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
translations.khattab: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him
translations.arberry: Lord of the heavens and earth, and all that between them is, the All-merciful of whom they have no power to speak.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا

translations.saheeh: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
translations.pickthall: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
translations.khattab: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it
translations.arberry: What, are you stronger in constitution or the heaven He built?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡ

translations.saheeh: And when the sky is stripped away
translations.pickthall: And when the sky is torn away,
translations.khattab: and when the sky is stripped away
translations.arberry: when heaven shall be stripped off;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ

translations.saheeh: When the sky breaks apart
translations.pickthall: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
translations.khattab: When the sky splits open
translations.arberry: When heaven is split open,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ

translations.saheeh: When the sky has split [open]
translations.pickthall: When the heaven is split asunder
translations.khattab: When the sky bursts open
translations.arberry: When heaven is rent asunder

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡبُرُوجِ

translations.saheeh: By the sky containing great stars
translations.pickthall: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
translations.khattab: By the sky full of constellations
translations.arberry: By heaven of the constellations,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ

translations.saheeh: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
translations.pickthall: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
translations.khattab: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things
translations.arberry: God to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and God is Witness over everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ

translations.saheeh: By the sky and the night comer -
translations.pickthall: By the heaven and the Morning Star
translations.khattab: By the heaven and the nightly star
translations.arberry: By heaven and the night-star!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجۡعِ

translations.saheeh: By the sky which returns [rain]
translations.pickthall: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
translations.khattab: By the sky with its recurring cycles
translations.arberry: By heaven of the returning rain,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَى

translations.saheeh: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
translations.pickthall: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
translations.khattab: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High
translations.arberry: Magnify the Name of thy Lord the Most High

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ

translations.saheeh: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
translations.pickthall: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
translations.khattab: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray
translations.arberry: and mentions the Name of his Lord, and prays.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ رُفِعَتۡ

translations.saheeh: And at the sky - how it is raised?
translations.pickthall: And the heaven, how it is raised?
translations.khattab: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺
translations.arberry: how heaven was lifted up,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا

translations.pickthall: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
translations.khattab: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it
translations.arberry: By the heaven and That which built it

translations.saheeh: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
translations.pickthall: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
translations.khattab: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—
translations.arberry: Recite: In the Name of thy Lord who created,
